Subject: Hosted API - minimum monthly expectation / pilot options

Hi Jonas,

We’re kicking off an internal evaluation of hosted inference for our chat assistant and want to understand what kind of minimum monthly spend or commit you expect for teams that aren’t ready for Dedicated yet. Two quick asks: (1) can you share your current published rate card and any standard pilot/flex packaging? (2) how do you handle spikes / overages for small pilots — are there safety nets or caps we can put in place?

We’re a 12-engineer startup; short-term forecast is modest, but we want to avoid surprise bills if usage spikes during a launch. Procurement will need a ballpark to decide whether to raise a PO for a pilot.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call this week.

— Leah

leah@scaleup.ai

Subject: Re: Hosted API - minimum monthly expectation / pilot options

Hi Leah — great to hear from you and congrats on the evaluation. Short answers up front, then options: I’ve attached our most recent rate card and a short "Method of Purchase" draft that spells out billing flows.

Options we typically offer for teams not ready for Dedicated:

1) Pay-as-you-go (no minimum) — standard hosted per-token pricing on the attached rate card. Best if you’re comfortable with variable usage; we surface daily usage alerts and spend caps you can set in Console.

2) Low-commit pilot retainer — a small monthly floor in exchange for a modest discount and pilot credits. Example: $2,000/mo floor for first 3 months -> 10% effective discount against usage up to the floor, plus a 100k-token pilot credit applied up front. Rollover is negotiable (see below).

3) Bridge/bucket model — upfront prepaid token bucket (e.g., $5k credit) that draws down and can be topped up. Useful if procurement prefers a prepaid PO.

Safety-net & spike handling:
- Overage cap: we can set an overage cap (for pilots) that limits monthly spend above the floor to a multiplier (e.g., 2x the floor) and triggers soft throttling and account owner alerts.
- Alerts + approvals: we’ll configure threshold notifications at 50/75/90% of the floor and require an explicit approval for charges above the cap.
- Pause option: you can pause API keys or enable stricter throttles programmatically via Console.

Billing cadence: monthly invoices, Net 30 standard. For prepaids, we can accept a PO for an upfront credit and draw down.

I’ve looped in Marissa for discount approvals and Aditya for any security/compliance questions you’ll have (SOC 2 evidence, data retention, VPC/private deployment timeline if you need that later).

If you’re available, I can send a short pilot quote reflecting the $2k retainer + pilot credit today for procurement review. Otherwise, happy to take the $1.5k option if you prefer a lower floor — I’ll need Marissa to OK it.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Thanks Jonas — that helps a lot. A few clarifying items from procurement and the product team: 

• Would Redwood consider a temporary lower floor for Q4 (our launch window) — e.g., $1,500/mo for the first 90 days — in exchange for a short case study or reference if things go well?
• On rollover: can unused credits from the retainer roll forward two months? We expect usage to ramp, so that smoothing would help with forecasting.
• Invoice terms: procurement prefers monthly invoices but we can do prepaid if Redwood prefers.

Also, do you have a one-pager we can share with execs that summarizes the pilot protections (caps, alerts, approval flow)? Procurement will need that to sign a PO.

If you can send a quote with both $1.5k and $2k floor options, we’ll fast-track this.

— Leah

Subject: Re: Hosted API - minimum monthly expectation / pilot options

Leah — appreciate the proposal and the case study offer. I’ve reviewed with finance and we can approve a conditional pilot package with the following guardrails: 

- Approved pilot floor: $2,000/mo for the first 90 days. (We can reduce to $1,500 only if ScaleUp commits to a formal case study and a brief customer video.)
- Discount: 10% effective discount applied to usage up to the floor during the 90-day pilot.
- Rollover: unused portion of the floor may roll forward up to two months, but rollforward cannot exceed the total pilot floor value across the 90-day window.
- Overage protection: cap overage at 2x monthly floor for the pilot period; charges above that require explicit sign-off from ScaleUp.
- Billing: monthly invoice, Net 30. Prepaid buckets accepted via PO.
- Legal: pilot will use our standard MSA addendum; legal needs to sign before any credits are applied.

Jonas — please prepare an updated quote and MoP reflecting these terms and include the MSA addendum link. Aditya, please attach the SOC 2 type II report and a short one-pager on pilot protections for Leah’s execs.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
